name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.login.view.ResetPasswordActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this page when a user recovers a login password. It verifies the phone number with image and SMS codes before submitting the reset.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from recovering a forgotten login password.
